rule: One damage call per hit, in this order: (1) blood or puff at the hit point, sized by raw damage; (2) knockback impulse = damage x scale / victim mass, applied even to an immune victim; (3) immunity gate returns before armour, health and flash (below 1000 damage); (4) armour soaks one third or one half until empty, health takes the rest; (5) flash counter += damage, capped at 100, drains one point per tick in life; (6) death at health <= 0, overkill gib when health is below minus the kind's spawn health; (7) pain roll: flinch and pain state when a 0-255 roll is below the kind's painchance, otherwise nothing visible; (8) threat: an unlocked victim takes the hitter as target and locks for 100 ticks. Client per tick: tint band = ceiling(counter / 8), capped at 7; pain voice is the action of the second pain frame, about 4 ticks after the hit.

data_fields.name: knockbackScale
data_fields.unit: map units per tick per (damage / mass)

data_fields.name: armourSoakFraction
data_fields.unit: fraction of hit per armour tier

data_fields.name: ouchThreshold
data_fields.unit: hp drop in one tick for the big-hit face

keep: Order of steps inside one hit: visual, knockback, immunity gate, armour, health, flash, death, flinch roll, threat lock
Per-kind flinch roll on the same call as the damage; a missed roll means no flinch
Pain voice tied to the flinch frame, so voice and stagger are one event
Banded and capped red tint, one band per fixed damage step
Three blood sizes by raw damage
Threat lock: the first hitter keeps the target for a fixed window (hate-list rule, row 4)
Death camera turns toward the killer and drops to a low height
Overkill gib threshold per kind, not one global number
change: Ouch face test is sign-inverted (st_stuff.c 807, 860 against st_oldhealth at 994): fix to previous minus now
Rumble call is a stub (p_inter.c 883 calls I_Tactile; i_system.c 55-61 does nothing): implement on client or drop
Voice is silent when the flinch roll misses: play a contact cue on every landed hit; voice stays a separate per-victim gated event
Immunity order: knockback applies but armour is not spent; decide once for the ledger (guard blocks knockback too, proposed)
Presentation: client-only; the flinch roll uses the fight's seeded RNG; the client never rolls
look_test: Three presets on a one-versus-three fight behind a debug flag: (A) current feel; (B) donor order with banded tint capped at 7 bands, per-kind flinch roll (near-always for light kinds, rare for the heaviest), ouch face fixed; (C) B plus a half-second voice gate and a kick toward the hitter. Dom plays ten hits per preset at 375 wide and judges: can you tell which of three hit you, does the tint hide the enemies, does a heavy foe look heavy without a flinch. Preview folder only, no release rows, no lock.
